The '''Gazzari Minor system''', also known as the '''Gazzarri system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Garis sector/Legends|Garis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
The [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Sebolto]] ran a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] operation in this system at some point prior to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].

Sebolto's dealings in the Gazzari Minor system were leaked to the [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic Security Force]] by [[Bendix Fust]], which led to Sebolto losing a huge amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. In revenge, Sebolto placed a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on Fust's head, eventually collected by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] during [[The Hunt]].

[[Montross (bounty hunter)|Montross]], also taking part in The Hunt also went there because [[Groff Haugg]] lied to him in order to divert him away from the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]]. However, Montross learned of Bendix Fust and what was happening on [[Oovo IV/Legends|Oovo IV]] which managed to get him back on track.

==Behind the scenes==
[[Jason Fry]] confirmed that the Gazzari Minor system was invented to account for mapping discrepancies between [[Knight Errant (novel)|''Knight Errant'']] and previous sources.<ref name="Atlas">{{JCFCite|url=posts/31618818|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=[[Jason Fry|jasonfy]]|date=2011-03-26|time=10:52 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20191013233754/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-163|quote=Of that list of systems, Gultanna, Manoe, Opitha Tren and Thory Prime were created for the appendix, basically for bookkeeping purposes so every sector would be associated with at least one system. The others are all established worlds.}}</ref>
